increase_rationale: 31 HISS-02 findings from the Go I/O deadline rule (praetor #510) are lifecycle-owned fx service loops, log/channel sinks, callee-bounded calls or context-ignoring constructors, not unbounded I/O; reported upstream as https://github.com/cordanaLLM/praetor/issues/841. The two genuine findings (systemd sd_notify dial, testutil/pg teardown) were fixed. Remove these entries when the rule handles these shapes.
